messages.subject: X-axis with correctly ordered months
parts:
Hi,

I have a simple dataframe with measured values for each month of a
year. The months
are represented by the vector: months.abbr


How can I make the X axis to show the months in the correct order? At
the moment they
are sorted according to the alphabet.

Here a short example:

df1 <- data.frame(Y=rnorm(12,1),X=month.abb,type="A")
ggplot(df1)+
geom_line(aes(x=X,y=Y,group=type))

/Johanes

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: X-axis with correctly ordered months
parts:
You can do two things. 
  1. Convert your month to a Date using as.Date()
    • http://www.statmethods.net/input/dates.html
  2. Change the order of your months using factor()
    • ?factor(), order with levels=c("Jan", "Feb", etc...)
